scope: The retained default-trace, corotational, load-controlled elastic circular-arc families only
basis: All six historical source snapshot hashes were checked against the retained nx32 case; the first selected entry snapshot was rejected because two hashes did not match, then the exact handoff snapshot was selected
arc_reference.py and assessment_support.py are byte-identical to the historical case: geometry, loading, independent oracle and equilibrium/constraint checks are unchanged

All native element constitutive/energy/force methods and corotational work-conjugate response methods are AST-identical; elements.py changes only coupling constructor and descriptor validation with the existing True default

corotational.py changes only add director_trace_geometry=None and guarded opt-in director branches; linear-trace correction, Jacobian, pullback and geometric-tangent arithmetic remain unchanged when that field is None

mesh_gen.py changes add strict bool/default-linear admission and opt-in director descriptors; the manual arc builder uses the existing True/linear defaults, and the default linear constraint arithmetic is unchanged

nonlinear_static.py changes are confined to displacement control plus a rejection guard for director traces with non-corotational kinematics; neither executes on the benchmark's corotational load-control route
Historical runtime uses the same Python3.13.9, NumPy2.4.3, SciPy1.16.3, Numba0.65.0 and one-thread numerical pools; each new invocation independently verifies its effective runtime
procedural_adoption: Retained and new default-family values may be compared under this explicit root impact assessment. Keep every raw source identity and the original strict identities_match result; never rewrite hashes, relabel historical solves as current-source executions, or claim raw identity equality.
summary_requirements: Preserve the unchanged original accuracy, refinement, completion, equilibrium and coverage predicates
Expose raw source_identity equality separately from root-adjudicated active-path equivalence
Validate all contributing historical source/oracle fingerprints against the audited historical identity; validate all new fingerprints against the frozen candidate/current oracle
Do not merge director_integrated results into the default family
Root retains final acceptance, and any other source/configuration delta requires separate impact assessment
not_evidence_of: Convergence, completion of missing cases, accuracy at the new refinement, or acceptance of all Slice3
review: Root non-author integration/contract assessment; no additional full Astra-high progress review
